                    ### Question
                    A 27-year-old Hispanic G2P1 presents for a routine antepartum visit at 26 weeks gestation. She has no complaints. The fasting blood glucose level is 138 mg/dL (7.7 mmol/L), and the HbA1c is 7%. Which of the following represents the proper initial management?
